old: हे अग्नि, वह तुम्हारी सहायताओं से, जो वीरों से युक्त और बल देने वाले कर्मों से भरी हैं, आगे बढ़ता है; जिसकी मित्रता का तुमने पालन किया है।

old: Praise him, the god, the leader of the light of heaven, whom the gods have set as their attendant, to carry the oblation among the gods.

old: हमने तुम्हें चुना है, सर्वश्रेष्ठ यजन करने वाले, देवों में देव, होता, अमर, इस यज्ञ के उत्तम संकल्प वाले को।

old: Sing that for yourselves together, when the Soma is pressed, to the much-invoked, the brave one; that which is welfare, as for a cow, for the capable one.
new: Sing that for yourselves together, when (the Soma) is pressed, to the much-invoked, the brave one; that which is welfare, as for a cow, for the capable one.

old: The Rigvedic parallel has 'made made' (in each exhilaration); madeḥ is taken here as a 2 sg. optative of √mad, but this is uncertain.

old: śrutakakṣāram = śrutakakṣa + aram; Śrutakakṣa is taken as a vocative proper name (a sage's name). 'What is fitting' is supplied after gāyata.
new: śrutakakṣāram = śrutakakṣa + aram; Śrutakakṣa is taken as a vocative proper name. 'What is fitting' is supplied after gāyata.
why: reviewer (minor): 'a sage's name' is not stated by the line; gloss 'O Śrutakakṣa (name)' is enough.

old: We urge on that Indra to victory, to slay the great Vṛtra; may he be the bull, the steer.
new: We urge on that Indra to victory, to slay the great Vṛtra; may he be the mighty one, the bull.
why: reviewer (error): 'steer' means a castrated ox; vṛṣabha is 'bull'. Hindi 'बैल और वृषभ' adds 'and' and repeats the same animal.

old: उस इन्द्र को हम वृत्र को मारने के लिए बल-विजय हेतु प्रेरित करते हैं; वह बैल और वृषभ हो जाए।

old: You, O Indra, are born of strength, of might, of vigour; being a bull, O bull, you are indeed a bull.
new: You, O Indra, are born of strength, of might, of vigour; being so, O bull, you are indeed a bull.

old: sanvṛṣanvṛṣedasi is parsed san vṛṣan vṛṣā id asi ('being, O bull, a bull indeed you are'); the Rigvedic parallel has 'tvaṃ vṛṣan vṛṣed asi', so san is an extra word here and the parsing is uncertain.
new: sanvṛṣanvṛṣedasi is parsed san vṛṣan vṛṣā id asi ('being, O bull, a bull indeed you are'); the parsing is uncertain.
why: reviewer (minor): Imports the Rigvedic reading (see unit 116).
